phase_name: Validated automatic promotion — the Dojo enacts its own recommendation
files_migrated: EXTEND src/spy_der/learning/learner.py (no staging without a live knob)
files_deferred: 0DTE dashboard rendering of the promotion phase lands in the 0DTE PR
Per-archetype promotion gates (currently aggregate synthetic panel only)
behavior_preserved: Live trading remains disabled; promotion changes shadow decisions only.
Human promotion path intact — promote_pending still demands 'PROMOTE'.
Offline Dojo defaults to deterministic agents (no Grok spend).
Promotion knobs can only reduce exposure: size is capped, never lifted.
intentional_changes: The Dojo promotes automatically when a re-run under the recommended change beats the incumbent on every gate.
champion.json is read by the live decision path, so a promotion changes decisions.
A hypothesis that changes no live decision knob is no longer staged as a promotion recommendation.
Hypotheses carry one knob each so a trial result is attributable.
known_gaps: risk_max_size_scalar cannot win a trial on its own: the evaluator scores realized P&L per matched trade and ignores size, so a pure size change shows no edge and is refused.
A confidence floor is all-or-nothing on tape where the deterministic agent reports a flat 0.5 confidence; such candidates fail the evidence gate rather than promoting.
rollback: SPY_DER_CHAMPION_KNOBS=0 makes the live path ignore a promoted config.
spy_der.learning.promotion.rollback_champion() restores the archived champion from configs/champion_history/.
next_phase: 0DTE dashboard: render the promotion phase (verdict, gates, incumbent vs candidate).
